page.title: Joby Aviation | Electric Air Taxi for Zero-Emission Travel | Joby Aviation
page.bodyText:
Skip traffic.
Time to fly.

The future of aviation is coming soon.

Elevate your commute with our
all-electric air taxi, soon to be
bookable at the tap of a
button.

Zero traffic. Zero operating
emissions. Just the space and
time your day deserves.

Let's fly
1

Leave city congestion behind and choose a
stress-free commute through the clouds.

2

Sit back and enjoy.
Breathtaking views come standard with
every seat.

3

Enjoy seamless travel with a choreographed
rideshare to the vertiport.

Skip town, let’s fly
Imagine looking forward to
your commute. And
forgetting what gridlock
feels like. When flight is a
part of everyday life,
anything is possible.
Discover the Experience
Discover the Experience
Seamless door to door
travel, all from a few taps
on our app.
Technology that makes
the dream possible
